versions.changelog:
Initial release: Provides real-time probabilistic regime transition forecasts with timing estimates from APEX Runner’s live trading system.

- Offers quantification of regime transition risks and timing for dynamic strategy allocation and hedging
- No API account or subscription required; access with EVM wallet and USDC payments via x402 authentication
- Early adopter and loyalty pricing tiers available automatically based on wallet usage
- Sample code and response examples provided for rapid integration
